The *Todeyyamāṇavapucchāniddesa* (Cnd 13) is a canonical commentary belonging to the *Cūḷaniddesa* section of the Khuddaka Nikāya [SuttaCentral]. Translated as the "Exposition of the Questions of the Student Todeyya," it provides a detailed exegetical analysis of the *Todeyyamāṇavapucchā*, the tenth discourse of the Pārāyanavagga of the *Sutta Nipāta* (Snp 5.10) [SuttaCentral]. SuttaCentral lists two translations of the text in two languages [SuttaCentral].

Text-reuse analysis reflects the highly formulaic and repetitive exegetical methodology characteristic of the Niddesa literature. DharmaNexus identifies 762 matching passages shared between the *Todeyyamāṇavapucchāniddesa* and 41 other Pali texts [DharmaNexus]. Its most extensive textual overlaps occur with other chapters of the *Mahāniddesa* and *Cūḷaniddesa*, notably the *Purābhedasuttaniddesa* (Mnd 10), *Upasīvamāṇavapucchāniddesa* (Cnd 10), *Dhotakamāṇavapucchāniddesa* (Cnd 9), *Jatukaṇṇimāṇavapucchāniddesa* (Cnd 15), and *Khaggavisāṇasuttaniddesa* (Cnd 23) [DharmaNexus]. DharmaNexus and SuttaCentral both confirm text-sharing with its root verses in the *Todeyyamāṇavapucchā* (Snp 5.10) and the preliminary question section (*Pucchā*, Cnd 2) [SuttaCentral; DharmaNexus].
